tools.name: hotjar_list_surveys
tools.description: List the surveys of one Hotjar site: id, name, type (link, full_screen, popover), enabled state and creation time. Set with_questions to include each survey's questions. Returns results and next_cursor (null on the last page).

tools.name: hotjar_get_survey
tools.description: Get one survey with its questions (id, text, type, choices, labels). Use the question ids to read the answers from hotjar_list_survey_responses.

tools.name: hotjar_list_survey_responses
tools.description: List the responses to one survey, newest first (the API cannot filter by date). Each response has answers (question_id, answer, comment, tags, sentiment), device, browser, country, origin URL and user attributes. Needs an Ask Scale plan. Returns results and next_cursor (null on the last page).
